sth.text: Ertai is captured by Greven il-Vec and taken to the Stronghold.
There he secretly helps Crovax win the duel against Volrath.
Eladamri then kills Belbe and flees to Dominaria, leaving Ertai to submit to Crovax.

exo.text: Ertai stands alone, focused on opening the arcane portal before his comrades return.
When he sends word that the portal is open, Lyna cries that it will not stay open for long.

nem.text: Ertai is captured aboard the Predator after the Weatherlight escapes Rath, and in the Stronghold Belbe shortlists him, along with Crovax and Greven il-Vec, as evincar, preferring Ertai.
Belbe grows disillusioned with Phyrexia and falls in love with him, but when Volrath returns to challenge Crovax, Ertai sabotages him.
Belbe is forced to crown Crovax evincar, Volrath is executed, and Crovax has Ertai compleated, turning him into a mutated servant who takes Belbe's skull from her funeral pyre.

dmu.text: Centuries later Sheoldred resurrects Ertai, who takes control of the academy at Lat-Nam, and at the Oyster Bay peace summit sleeper agents abduct Aron Capashen so that Ertai can oversee his compleation.
Ertai emerges from a cave with the compleated Aron, orders him to attack Danitha, and summons a Phyrexian dreadnought, threatening everyone unless Jaya and Ajani surrender.
Disguised as Bulp, he later reveals himself to Squee, compleats Squee's goblin clan and plans to deliver Squee to New Phyrexia for study.
At the Battle of the Mana Rig Ertai leads an attack on Karn and is last seen stumbling over the edge before the Rig's self-destruction.
